default_off_writes.scope: Strict native production SDK on disposable local xfs. Timed latency excludes content generation; timed process CPU and phase wall include content generation. RSS is cumulative process high-water across shapes, not per-case native heap. Per-leg P99 has 200 samples and cannot certify tail dominance. Fresh processes, shared host; no performance credit for compile-overlapped driver validation.

longer_confirmation.purpose: Longer confirmation justified by 200-sample P99 regressions in initial cohort. Separate fresh processes; original adverse rows retained. No compile overlap.

limits: Disposable local xfs strict native production SDK; no new SQLite comparison or universal dominance certification.
P99 averages per-leg quantiles, not pooled percentiles: initially 200 samples, confirmation 2000 small / 1000 large per leg. All adverse results retained.
Latency excludes content generation; CPU/phase wall includes generation. Point-read CPU includes exact checks. RSS is process high-water, initially cumulative across four shapes.
